definitions.gloss: vinegar-miso dressing (miso mixed with vinegar and sugar)
definitions.explanation: A classic Japanese dressing made by mixing miso, vinegar, and sugar (often with mirin). Used on simmered greens, seafood, and {和|あ}え{物|もの} (dressed dishes).

examples.japanese: {酢味噌|すみそ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{和|あ}えた→和える：05824_aeru⟧。
{酢味噌|すみそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白味噌|しろみそ}→白味噌：28917_shiromiso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using white miso gives sumiso a refined flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茹|ゆ}でた→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧{蛍烏賊|ほたるいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酢味噌|すみそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: Boiled firefly squid with sumiso poured over it is one of my springtime pleasures.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar) + ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ (miso). A basic homemade dressing in Japanese cooking; supermarkets also sell ready-made versions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酢味噌|すみそ}{和|あ}え: dish dressed with vinegar-miso
- {酢味噌|すみそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to pour sumiso over
- {辛子|からし}{酢味噌|すみそ}: mustard vinegar-miso (with Japanese mustard)
- ⟦{葱|ねぎ}→葱：05189_negi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢味噌|すみそ}{和|あ}え: green onions dressed with sumiso

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: miso — base ingredient
- ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧: vinegar — base ingredient
- ぬた: a {酢味噌|すみそ}-dressed dish (especially with green onions and seafood)
